customer: Hello, I recently moved to Eastvale and I'm hoping to sell my midsize SUV to you. The title still has my maiden name on it, but my driver's license shows my married name. Could you please tell me what I'll need to bring?
agent: Thank you for reaching out, and welcome to Eastvale! According to our article "The name on the title doesn't match my ID," please bring the document that shows your name change, such as your marriage certificate. You'll also sign the name change affidavit, form NW-NMC-1, at your appointment. If you notice a spelling mistake on the title, please ask your state's motor vehicle agency to correct it first.
